steps.input:
n=19
sources=[(4,7,8),(5,14,4),(13,15,1),(15,4,2)]
perim=set()
for r,c,v in sources:
 perim.update([(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)])
# zero cross axes center (11,9), perimeter 3s
blank=(11,9); blankmarks={(10,9),(11,8),(11,10),(12,9)}
# Build horizontal/vertical rays; stop at another colored source's 3-arm marker
h=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]; vgrid=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
for r,c,val in sources:
 for dr,dc,target in [(0,1,h),(0,-1,h),(1,0,vgrid),(-1,0,vgrid)]:
  rr,cc=r,c
  while 1<=rr<=n and 1<=cc<=n:
   # include source's own colored center and rays, but stop on other source's 3-arm
   if (rr,cc) in perim and (rr,cc) not in {(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)}:
    break
   target[rr-1][cc-1]=val
   rr+=dr;cc+=dc
# cross axes blank overwrite horizontal contributions, then vertical rays overwrite
out=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
for i in range(n):
 for j in range(n):
  if h[i][j] and not (i+1==blank[0] or j+1==blank[1]): out[i][j]=h[i][j]
  if vgrid[i][j]: out[i][j]=vgrid[i][j]
# mark all 3s
for r,c in perim|blankmarks:out[r-1][c-1]=3
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
